# Roles directory

Every role ID used in RACI charts, SOPs and agents. One person can hold several roles: in a small business, most people do.

## Executive

| Role ID | Title | Summary | Reports to | Also known as | In a small business |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="owner-ceo"></a>`owner-ceo` | Owner / CEO | Sets direction, owns final decisions on strategy, pricing policy and major commitments. |  | Founder, Managing Director, President | The owner |

## Sales

| Role ID | Title | Summary | Reports to | Also known as | In a small business |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="head-of-sales"></a>`head-of-sales` | Head of Sales | Owns revenue targets, sales process, forecast and team performance. | `owner-ceo` | VP Sales, Sales Director, Chief Revenue Officer | The owner, or the most senior seller |
| <a id="sales-manager"></a>`sales-manager` | Sales Manager | Coaches sellers, runs pipeline reviews, approves deals within delegated limits. | `head-of-sales` | Team Lead, Regional Manager | Usually merged with head-of-sales |
| <a id="account-executive"></a>`account-executive` | Account Executive | Runs opportunities from discovery to signed contract. | `sales-manager` | AE, Sales Rep, Closer, Business Development Manager | The owner or a generalist seller |
| <a id="sales-development-rep"></a>`sales-development-rep` | Sales Development Representative | Qualifies inbound leads and creates new opportunities through outbound prospecting. | `sales-manager` | SDR, BDR, Lead Qualifier, Inside Sales | The account executive, often with an AI agent doing the research and drafting |
| <a id="solutions-engineer"></a>`solutions-engineer` | Solutions Engineer | Shapes technical solutions, runs demos and scoping, validates feasibility before proposals. | `head-of-sales` | Sales Engineer, Pre-sales Consultant, Solutions Consultant | A senior delivery person pulled in per deal |
| <a id="sales-operations"></a>`sales-operations` | Sales Operations | Owns the CRM, data quality, reporting, forecasting mechanics and sales tooling. | `head-of-sales` | RevOps, Sales Ops Analyst, CRM Administrator | Whoever looks after the CRM, often the owner or an office manager |
